notes.back:
No. `team.name = "Platform"` fails: name is a read-only property. `team.members.push(...)` compiles.

Why: Readonly only stops reassigning the object's own properties. The array inside can still be changed, and nothing is enforced at run time.

Docs: TypeScript Handbook — Object Types — https://www.typescriptlang.org/docs/handbook/2/objects.html
notes.quote: Using the readonly modifier doesn't necessarily imply that a value is totally immutable - or in other words, that its internal contents can't be changed. It just means the property itself can't be re-written to.
